review_candidates.description: We are looking for a hands-on HR Director to lead our international People Operations function and build a transparent, performance-driven HR system. The HR Director will be responsible for the complete employee lifecycle after hiring: contracts, HR policies, performance management, compensation coordination, employee relations, professional growth, retention, disciplinary matters and offboarding. This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO. Work format This is a hybrid / remote position . The successful candidate may work: from our office in Panama; in a hybrid format; or fully remotely from another Latin American country. Regardless of location, full daily availability during Panama business hours (9am to 6pm) is mandatory. Occasional business travel may be required. Key responsibilities Lead the international People Operations and HR governance function. Develop HR strategy and support organizational design. Manage employee and contractor agreements, renewals and HR documentation. Coordinate recruitment in LATAM and EUROPE. Improve retention, trainings and onboarding. Maintain employee files, contract trackers and probation records. Develop and enforce HR policies and internal procedures. Manage performance reviews, KPIs and performance improvement plans. Handle employee relations, complaints, conflicts and disciplinary matters. Coordinate compensation, bonuses, benefits and payroll information. Build promotion, career-development and succession processes. Improve employee engagement and retention. Manage terminations, exit interviews and offboarding. Lead and develop the HR Generalist and future People Operations team. Maintain HR dashboards and provide regular reports to the CEO. Cooperate with the Global Talent Acquisition Director on workforce planning, hiring quality and probation success. Scope clarification The HR Director owns: People Operations; contracts and HR documentation; performance management; compensation and benefits; employee relations; policies and compliance; employee development; retention and offboarding. Daily sourcing, candidate acquisition and management of Recruiters are owned by the separate Global Talent Acquisition Director while that function is active. The HR Director remains responsible for business continuity and may temporarily assume recruitment governance if the Global Talent Acquisition position becomes vacant. Requirements Requirements At least 5 years of experience as an HR Director, Head of HR or senior HR leader. A university degree is a must, or a master's degree is preferred. Strong experience in International recruitment (demonstrated) Strong experience managing the full employee lifecycle. Proven experience with performance management, employee relations and terminations. Experience developing and enforcing HR policies. Experience managing remote or international teams. Strong knowledge of HR operations, contracts and compensation processes. Experience managing an HR team. English at C1 level or equivalent. Spanish at C1 level or native proficiency. Strong judgment, confidentiality and decision-making ability. Ability to work independently and communicate directly with the CEO. Availability during Panama business hours (9am to 6pm Panama time) Candidates based in Latin America are strongly preferred. Benefits What we offer MONTHLY Salary range from: USD $3.500 to 5.000 according to experience. Director-level position with direct access to the CEO. International scope across Europe and the Americas. Hybrid or fully remote work format. Opportunity to build and improve the HR function. Real decision-making authority within the approved scope. Long-term cooperation. Fixed monthly compensation plus performance-based incentives. Contract format based on the candidate's country of residence.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights. Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect , you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies . This is also a stakeholder-facing role . Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability. What You'll Do Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences. Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems. Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics. Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services. Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases. Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis. Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions. Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights. Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements. Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems. Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers. What We're Looking For Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience. 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role. 3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards. Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets. Experience with dimensional data modelling. Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms. Experience with Python/Pandas. Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases. Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources. Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions. Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving. Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate. Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel. Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment. Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices. Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards. Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset. Who Will Succeed In This Role You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively . You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions. ,

review_candidates.title: BI Developer
review_candidates.description: Want to know how a leading workplace experience and facility management company is powered by technology? At ISS Tech Team, we create smarter workplace experiences through technology. Our Global Technology Solutions team builds digital solutions, from sensors and IoT devices to data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities, that support our ISS A/S operations across Cleaning, Workplace, Food and Technical Services. With tech hubs in Copenhagen, Warsaw, and Porto, and teams collaborating across more than 30 countries, our ISS Tech team develops our digital solutions that have a real impact on both our customers and our people. Location: Porto, Portugal Work regime: Hybrid The Job Role As BI Developer In this role, you’ll help maintain and evolve the BI layer of our CRM, supporting sales performance monitoring, business development, customer analytics and senior leadership reporting across Group functions and countries. You’ll maintain and evolve CRM BI data flows and Power BI semantic models, troubleshoot technical issues affecting reporting and key business processes, and ensure reliable data is available for business reporting. You’ll also support the Principal CRM Developer with Dynamics 365 Sales and Power Platform improvements. Based in our Porto tech hub, you’ll work alongside the Product Owner and Principal CRM Developer, collaborating with the Commercial Analytics team and colleagues across Warsaw and Copenhagen. You’ll help maintain technical and operational documentation, build an understanding of the CRM BI architecture and its dependencies, and contribute to continuous improvement and future modernisation alongside technical specialists. Your work will strengthen the platform’s long-term maintainability. Your curiosity about how CRM data supports the business will help you understand reporting requests and the context behind requirements, and contribute to practical technical solutions that enable the Commercial Analytics team to deliver high-quality sales reporting. As you contribute to the team’s success, you’ll also have opportunities to grow personally and professionally with ISS. What You’ll Do In this role, you’ll help keep our CRM BI and Dynamics 365 Sales solutions running smoothly and evolving to meet business needs. Your key responsibilities will include: Operate and support the end-to-end data flows between Microsoft Dataverse, Azure SQL and Power BI, monitoring scheduled refreshes and troubleshooting data availability, semantic model and reporting issues. Maintain and evolve existing Power BI semantic models and supporting data structures in the SQL layer, and contribute to the development of new models based on changes in Dynamics 365 Sales and requirements from the Commercial Analytics team. Administer CRM Power BI workspaces and deployment pipelines, maintain and support the analytics security model, and assist with the controlled release of BI changes. Maintain CRM BI technical and operational documentation and contribute to continuous improvement and future architecture modernisation. Contribute to new CRM initiatives by supporting technical analysis, solution development, testing, documentation and release activities, working closely with the Product Owner, Principal CRM Developer and relevant business and technical stakeholders. Support the Principal CRM Developer with the configuration, development, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales and Power Platform solutions required for daily operations. Collaborate with stakeholders across Group functions and countries to clarify data and reporting requirements, resolve technical issues and support recurring reporting exercises. Key Qualifications Must have : At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modelling, semantic models, Power Query, DAX and refresh processes. Practical knowledge of SQL, including querying and troubleshooting data across tables and views, identifying inconsistencies and validating data transformations and model outputs. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dataverse and SQL-based reporting environments, including the ability to maintain data integrations and troubleshoot data flows and dependencies Hands-on experience with Power BI workspaces, deployment pipelines, CI/CD practices and reporting security configuration. English proficiency, both written and spoken. Nice Have Foundational experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales and Power Platform configuration and development. Knowledge of or hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, particularly its data warehousing and analytics capabilities. Experience with Power BI report design and data visualisation. Personal Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to troubleshooting. A team player mindset and effective communication within a multi-functional team. Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, manage competing demands and meet deadlines. What ISS Offers You We focus on creating an environment where you can grow and perform at your best: Permanent contract. Competitive compensation package based on your experience, including private health insurance. 22 days of annual leave + 3 additional company days to recharge. Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that supports balance and collaboration. Continuous learning opportunities (technical and behavioural development) to support your growth. Modern, well-equipped office in the heart of Porto. Free parking for your convenience. Access to ISS Tech Communities to connect, learn and share knowledge. Free access to the company gym to support your wellbeing. Snacks and drinks available at the office. Why ISS At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too. ISS is a Place to Be You. Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger. Become more. Become ISS. ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

Job Summary: The Technical Software Support Engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance and support to end-users related to i2 software applications, resolving technical issues, and ensuring optimal performance of i2 software. This role involves direct interaction with customers, diagnosing and troubleshooting software problems, and collaborating with development teams to enhance software functionality. The successful candidate will be an experienced support professional who is comfortable taking ownership of complex technical and customer-facing issues and working collaboratively within a geographically distributed international support team. Key Responsibilities Technical Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat promptly and professionally. Diagnose and troubleshoot software issues reported by end-users. Provide step-by-step technical assistance to resolve application problems. Support enterprise software applications across complex customer environments. Issue Resolution Identify, document, and resolve software bugs and issues. Take ownership of complex or escalated technical issues, coordinating with Development, QA (Quality Assurance), and Product teams as appropriate to drive issues towards resolution. Escalate issues to higher-level support or development teams when necessary. Follow up with customers to ensure issues are fully resolved. Customer Service Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through courteous and efficient handling of support requests. Provide regular updates to customers regarding the status of their support tickets. Conduct follow-up communications to ensure customer issues are resolved to their satisfaction. Documentation Document support requests, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the ticketing system. Create and update knowledge base articles and technical documentation for internal and external use. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and support activities. Collaboration Work closely with development, QA (Quality Assurance), and Product teams to provide feedback on recurring issues and suggest improvements. Participate in team meetings and training sessions to stay updated on new features, tools, and best practices. Support the coordination of day-to-day team activities when required, helping to maintain effective customer coverage and prioritization of support requests. Provide guidance and support to colleagues, promoting effective knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving. Continuous Improvement Identify trends in support requests and recommend solutions to improve software performance and user experience. Stay current with the latest industry trends, software updates, and support best practices. Contribute to the ongoing development of team processes, technical knowledge, and support practices. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. (Essential). (Desirable) Experience supporting enterprise software applications in complex customer environments. (Desirable) Experience with software troubleshooting and diagnostic tools. (Desirable) Familiarity with ticketing systems and customer support software (e.g., Salesforce, JIRA). (Desirable) Familiarity with i2 Software. (Desirable) Previous experience in a senior, lead, mentoring, or coordinating role within a technical support environment.
